review: Let me be clear about the scale. I run after-school programming at three sites, two hundred children, and I build every single session on a playlist. "God Is Stronger Than Big!" is in rotation at all three, which means two hundred families have heard your catalog and not one of them knows where it came from. And here is my problem — I am a nonprofit with a grant officer and I need to know in writing what I am licensed to play in a publicly-funded program. There is no page. I have looked. I am doing it anyway and that is a risk I am carrying personally and I would rather not.
